quotes.text: I don't have a backup plan. I have 'recreate it worse from memory' plan.
quotes.author: based

quotes.text: The best time to set up backups is before you need them. The second best time is immediately after you needed them.
quotes.author: based

quotes.text: Every production database needs a backup. Every backup needs a test. Every test needs a schedule.
quotes.author: based

quotes.text: The novice became suspicious and said: "Master, is all this 'Tao of Backup' stuff just so you can sell more copies of Veracity?" The master said: "Now you are truly enlightened."
quotes.author: ibotty
quotes.source: Hacker News — The Tao of Backup
quotes.extraction_note: Classic piece of dev folklore that still lands — self-aware guru grift delivered with perfect zen deadpan.

quotes.text: He returned to the master and said: "Master, you have the only uncorrupted copy!" But the master had already overwritten it with a copy of DOOM.
quotes.author: tovve
quotes.source: Hacker News — The Tao of Backup
quotes.extraction_note: Perfect comedic timing on a real engineering sin — DOOM overwriting the last good backup is universal dev humor.

quotes.text: You will only learn to make proper backups after you suffer a catastrophic loss of data. Protecting the student from this is depriving him of the only true knowledge, the one that is not merely stored in the head, but burned into the skin.
quotes.author: bambax
quotes.source: Hacker News — The Tao of Backup
quotes.extraction_note: Painfully accurate observation about how engineers actually learn ops lessons — suffering is the teacher.
